selection.selected_for: Readily available US development candidate; one per axle is project architecture, not OEM approval.
selection.not_selected_for: No rail application approval, pressure-envelope closure, guaranteed parking output or mount release.

availability.as_of: 2026-10-19 retrieval; seller states5:00AM CST inventory, no calendar date

dimensional_contract.coordinate_convention: Local s is pushrod extension direction. Mounting face s=0; chamber body is negative s; rod and future clevis positive s. Cross-plane axes and clocking are project choices, not OEM constraints established by this outline.
dimensional_contract.outline_limit: Catalog widths do not dimension every clamp ear, port fitting, hose, release-bolt storage pocket or tool sweep. Cylinder proxy is a preliminary envelope, not an exact OEM solid.
dimensional_contract.clevis_status: Aftermarket3420051 has bare threaded rod/no yoke; a dimensioned stock clevis and verified cut length/thread engagement are separate required selections.

stud_thread_conflict.resolution: OPEN; verify actual purchased revision/lot before choosing nuts and hole detail. Do not merge thread systems.

dimensional_contract.stud_length_status: Currentpage1.710in; not independently matched to brochure SAE version.
dimensional_contract.mass_status: Use conservative18lb for preliminary dead-load screening if needed; exact supplied mass unresolved.

caging.maintenance_extent: At least82.6mm beyond nut on rear head, plus nut/washer and actual hand-wrench/insertion clearance. Not82.6mm measured from body rear; complete tool envelope unverified.

orientation.applies: Every point in stroke, all directions, relative to normal of mounting face.
orientation.vertical_mount: Manual addresses vertical actuators and requires NPC drain holes low on sidewall near mounting face; exact3420051 drain location not established by GA, so vertical candidate remains conditional.
orientation.external_breather: If equipped, up/away from road; standardTR3420051 is not TR-T and no external tube is assumed.

force_and_pressure.maximum_permitted_pressure_status: Not established by retrieved exact-part OEM evidence.90–100psi manual test/caging pressure is not amaximum. Haldex150psi and WABCO10bar are not MGM ratings.
force_and_pressure.maximum_output_status: OPEN. Requires actual pressure controls/relief failure envelope, effective-area/force curve, zero-stroke spring output and simultaneous application treatment.

spring_table.evidence_status: Provisional primary-index extraction, not full current PDF verification; historicalOEMcopycrosscheck only.
spring_table.unpublished_range: 0<=stroke<1in not recovered; do not extrapolate as guaranteed maximum/minimum.
spring_table.not_a_parking_acceptance: Efficiency, rigging ratio, wear, lost motion, release pressure, preload, wheel friction, grade and anti-compounding remain design inputs.

theoretical_pressure_screen.area_basis: Nominal service-size20 label used as an engineering screening assumption, not measured effective area.
theoretical_pressure_screen.status: Illustrative sensitivities only. None of these pressures is declared permitted for this MGM part; PA is not OEM rated output and is not a proven conservative upper bound.

force_and_pressure.compounding: Until positive anti-compounding function and failure behavior are established, screen simultaneous service and spring forces at the same actual stroke. Present springtable does not cover below1in and cannot close the full envelope.

compact_comparison_not_selected.us_availability: No exact US retailerstock or USdelivery verified. ExistingIndianapplicationlisting alone doesnotmeet readilyavailableUS objective.
compact_comparison_not_selected.selection: Not selected; retained compact dimensionalcomparison only.

release_holds: Verify the supplied 3420051 mounting-thread revision and mass.
Obtain exact allowable pressure and current force curves, including the first inch of stroke.
Resolve simultaneous spring and service application, pressure regulation and failure behavior.
Confirm stock clevis dimensions, rod cut length, thread engagement and pin retention.
Check clamp, port, hose and caging access using the actual supplied assembly.
Verify the low NPC drain location if vertical mounting is used.
Qualify vibration, environment, endurance and complete braking and parking performance.
